execution.description: Moved battery's ladder map, pin sources and specimens into carbon/battery/admission_study.py, made the study sheet take a Challenge, wrote battery's sheet and inventory before and after, and ran the study, boundary, controller and mutation suites.

expected: Battery's sheet and inventory stay byte-identical; a synthetic second Challenge gets its own; an unmapped capability is refused.
observed: 82 passed. The before and after files are byte-identical and equal the committed docs/development/mira/level0 files. Battery's old map lacked the hybrid and prediction dimensions its contract uses, so a planner reading the map would have hit an unplaced dimension; the map now places them (GA-D1). Three earlier lessons had estimated recorded_at times and were corrected to the actual write times before this commit.
keep: Prove a refactor of a shared module with a byte comparison of the first Challenge's outputs before and after.
Register a Challenge's adapter in one hook, as challenge_registry.campaigns does.
change: A Challenge's ladder map must place every dimension its contract uses, not only its rebuildable ones; check it when the adapter is registered.
Take a lesson's recorded_at from the clock when it is written, never estimate it.
